classification.difficultyReason: Infer gradients from marked angles, use an intercept to form each equation, and rearrange into exact general form.

content.prompt: Determine the equation of each straight line sketched below in exact general form.

spec.description: Rising line crossing the y-axis at 4, with 45° marked at its negative x-intercept. Axes point in the positive directions; the line has arrows at both ends. No grid or additional ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: The intercept and angle are supplied; the equation is hidden.

spec.description: Falling line crossing the y-axis at 4, with the obtuse inclination of 120° marked from the positive horizontal ray at its positive x-intercept. No grid or additional ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: The intercept and inclination are supplied; the equation is hidden.

spec.description: Falling line crossing the x-axis at −6 and the y-axis below the origin. A clockwise curved arrow marks 30° between the line's upper-left ray and the upward vertical ray at the y-intercept. No grid or additional ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the x-intercept and angle are supplied; the inclination, gradient and equation are hidden.
